probes.quantity: fundamental frequency of an inviscid 2-D droplet (Lamb omega_2)

checks.detail: rms radius at the end of the recorded run over the droplet radius (r_eff/R = 4994.1); a capillary oscillation at eps = 0.1 must stay inside ~1.15 R
peak particle speed 1.818e+05 m/s over c0 = 20.0 m/s: beyond Mach 1 the Tait EOS has no meaning and the cloud is a spray, not a liquid
spread of the three independent frequency estimators (second moment / kinetic energy / zero crossing) divided by the reference: 41.50 … 361.46 rad/s vs 73.48 rad/s
coefficient of determination of the damped-cosine fit that produced the quoted frequency
sigma = 0 control of the sibling ladder reports 38.31 rad/s, i.e. 52.1 % of the reference: with no surface tension the same estimator sees lattice noise at more than half the Lamb frequency

probes.verdict_text: The recorded trajectory is not a droplet: containment and Mach gates fail by three to four orders of magnitude, two of the three frequency estimators disagree with each other by more than the reference itself, and the fit explains 37 % of the variance. This reading may not be graded FAIL (which asserts a measured physics defect); it is WITHHELD.
